context: Hiroshi-boss addresses staff formally about a new fiscal year.
purpose: Boss formal address register; polite/formal vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 皆様、新年度につきまして、お話し申し上げます。
lines.en: Everyone, I'd like to speak about the new fiscal year.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm formal courteous delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社長、今年度の目標は何でしょうか?
lines.en: Boss, what is this year's goal?
lines.style: composed office woman voice, soft warm respectful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 御協力のもと、完全に達成したいです。
lines.en: With your cooperation, I want to achieve it fully.
lines.style: professional boss voice, soft warm earnest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 皆、意欲を持っております。
lines.style: gentle office woman voice, soft warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それを聞いて、安心いたしました。
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm content delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 一緒に、頑張りましょう。
lines.style: soft office woman voice, warm warm committed delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よろしくお願い申し上げます。
lines.en: I'm counting on all of you.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm respectful delivery carefully
